questions.stem: If the side of a square is 6 cm, what is its area?
questions.solution: The area of a square is found by squaring the length of one of its sides. For a side of 6 cm, the area is 6 × 6 = 36 sq. cm. The other options are incorrect because 6 sq. cm is just the side length, 12 sq. cm could result from doubling the side, and 18 sq. cm might come from multiplying the side by 3 instead of itself.
